header.running_head: The Strength of the Imaan of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: In the chapter discussing the appointment of a Khalifah, the words of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) have passed, who said, "Are you scaring me with my Rabb? My prayer is, 'O Allaah! I have appointed the best of them to be my successor.'" In another narration he said, "I know Allaah and Umar better than you."

Also passed[^1] were the words of Hadhrat Umar (RA) when he decided to distribute all the funds in the state treasury and someone advised him to keep some behind in case an enemy attacks or for any other emergency. He said, "It is Shaytaan speaking with your tongue. Allaah has inspired me with the response and I swear by Allaah that I shall never disobey Him today for the emergencies of tomorrow. I shall not (do as you say) but shall rather prepare for the Muslims that which Rasulullaah ﷺ had prepared for them (obedience to Allaah and Rasulullaah ﷺ)." Another narration states that he said, "I swear by Allaah that I shall never disobey Him today for the emergencies of tomorrow."
Yet another narration quotes him as follows: "I have prepared Taqwa as a defence for the Muslims. Allaah mentions:

blocks.arabic_text: وَمَنْ يَّتَّقِ اللّٰهَ يَجْعَلْ لَّهٗ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَّيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ؕ
blocks.text: Allaah shall create an escape (from difficulties) for the one who fears (disobeying) Allaah (one who has Taqwa) and shall provide for him (what he requires) from sources that he never expected (to receive provisions from).

In the chapter discussing the fervour of the Sahabah (RA) to spend in the path of Allaah, the words of Hadhrat Ali (RA) are quoted thus: "The Imaan of a person cannot be true until he has more trust in that which is in Allaah's hands than that which is in his hands." This he said when he wanted to spend on a beggar and Hadhrat Faatima (RA) said, "You had left the six Dirhams to purchase flour."[^2]
Also quoted were the word of Hadhrat Aamir bin Rabee'ah (RA) who said, "I have no need for your land because today a Surah has been revealed that makes us oblivious of this world:

blocks.arabic_text: اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
blocks.text: Peoples' reckoning (the Day of Qiyaamah) has drawn near, yet (failing to take heed) they are turning away in negligence.[^3]
